title.en: Dynamical view — tokens on a sphere and attention as a time-varying graph
title.zh: 动力学视角——球面上的 token 与作为时变图的注意力机制

en.a: With RMSNorm, a token state is constrained to a sphere; attention supplies a state-dependent row-stochastic graph and its tangent vector field.
en.b: The dynamical view explains clustering and rank collapse only under stated assumptions. Residual paths and FFNs change the guarantee in different ways.

zh.a: 在 RMSNorm 下，token 状态被约束在球面上；注意力机制提供状态依赖的行随机图及其切向量场。
zh.b: 动力学视角仅在特定假设下解释聚类与秩崩溃现象。残差路径和前馈网络以不同方式改变该保证。
